promotions.behavior: Central identity policy validates canonical names and rejects malformed, reserved, prefixed, or duplicate names through an external uniqueness boundary.
assumptions: This proves Reforged policy behavior, not exact Classic naming rules.
promotions.runtimeImpact: Provides one validation boundary before Character identity creation or rename commits.
promotions.characterSaveImpact: Character remains owner of the accepted canonical name.

promotions.behavior: Titles are owner-scoped, permission-gated, deterministically ordered, and filtered by viewer visibility.
assumptions: Exact Classic title precedence remains native-dependent.
promotions.safeFallback: Ignore unknown titles and deny unauthorized grants.
promotions.runtimeImpact: Prevents arbitrary title injection while preserving subsystem ownership.
promotions.characterSaveImpact: Only title identifiers accepted by the owning subsystem may be stored.

promotions.behavior: Hidden identity and disguise presentation are viewer-relative and do not overwrite canonical Character identity.
assumptions: The literal anonymous label and native reveal rules remain unresolved.
promotions.safeFallback: Conceal from unprivileged viewers while retaining canonical identity for self and administrators.
promotions.runtimeImpact: Separates identity truth from presentation safely.
promotions.characterSaveImpact: Canonical name remains unchanged; disguise state belongs to its originating subsystem.
